incident-bot: Pager: Smart routing anomaly detected for APAC economy lane. p95 latency spike + error increase. Auto-escalation to #incidents. See PD: https://pd.redwood/INC-9876 :rotating_light:
maya: saw this, on it. pulling perf graphs and recent deploys. pinging @chris for on-call handoff.
chris: I got the page, taking lead. quick ask: scope — only APAC/economy? any customer-facing alerts yet?
maya: looks localized to APAC region, economy tier. metrics: errors up ~0.8% (baseline 0.05%), p95 latency jumped from ~120ms -> ~900ms for economy requests. Standard/dedicated largely unaffected. No large customers on economy but a handful of small PLG apps.
chris: ok. immediate mitigation options: 1) reduce economy tier weight for APAC routing, 2) enable temporary per-customer rate limit (lowers overload), 3) fall back economy -> standard for new sessions. I'll try (1) first.
olivia: I'm stepping in from rotation overlap in 5m if you want to hand off.
chris: handoff to @olivia in 5. executing weight change now (rolling, 30s window).
chris: exec: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://internal-console.redwood/api/routing/policies/update" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"region":"apac","policy":"tier_weights","weights":{"economy":0.25,"standard":0.55,"dedicated":0.20},"note":"emergency reduce economy weight due to latency spike"}'
```
incident-bot: Policy change submitted (event id: evt_20260317_001). Auto rollback timer set to 20m unless confirmed.
pagerduty-bot: Pager duty note: on-call chris acknowledged at 2026-03-17T16:02:13Z.
olivia: I see the policy change applied, watching metrics now.
ben: quick check on infra: no GPU OOMs, host metrics look fine. Net ingress for APAC economy spiked ~3x coincident with the latency window.
olivia: p95 now trending down to ~200ms (was 900ms). errors back to 0.18%. good signal.
maya: any visible customer errors from logs? I see a scattering of 429s from two orgs on economy — likely hitting the new rate limits, not 5xx.
chris: that's expected. prefer 429s over sustained 5xx/timeout for customers. I'll post a short customer-facing note to status in case it lingers.
olivia: next steps: keep reduced economy weight for another 10-15m, then try gradual ramp (canary 10% weight) while monitoring p95 and error budget. open follow-up task to analyze root cause (traffic pattern + routing interactions).
maya: assigning postmortem/owner: maya. I'll capture evals to reproduce using traffic replay.
ben: perf dashboards look stable. marking immediate mitigation successful.
chris: handing ops to olivia for monitoring window. I'll update PD incident and attach executed commands. :thumbsup:
olivia: taking watch. if p95 remains <250ms and errors <0.3% for 15m we can restore weights slowly.
incident-bot: Auto-rollback timer cancelled by olivia at 2026-03-17T16:14:12Z after confirm.
chris: filing incident ticket: https://issues.redwood/INC-9876-mitigation with summary and runbook steps.
maya: noted. I'll include timeline and affected org list.
olivia: thanks team — keeping this thread for the 30m watch; will post final close when done. :white_check_mark:
